description.narrative: The second phase of the Recognised Seasonal Employer (RSE) worker training programme provides English, numeracy and life-skills training to at least 1,200 Pacific RSE workers annually. The training allows workers to develop knowledge and skills that can be transferred home to address development needs of their families and communities. Skills obtained can be used to upskill others in the community, to support establishment of businesses, to obtain employment, or to improve living conditions.
